achievements.name: Conqueror of the New World
achievements.description: Unlock all achievements for Monster Hunter: World.

achievements.name: Welcome to the New World
achievements.description: Story: earn the right to take on two-star assignments.

achievements.name: Nothing Stops This Commission
achievements.description: Story: earn the right to take on three-star assignments.

achievements.name: Defender of Astera
achievements.description: Story: earn the right to take on four-star assignments.

achievements.name: Into the Deep
achievements.description: Story: earn the right to take on five-star assignments.

achievements.name: Death Begets Life
achievements.description: Story: successfully guide Zorah Magdaros in the escort mission.

achievements.name: The Empress of the Highlands
achievements.description: Story: earn the right to take on seven-star assignments.

achievements.name: One Shall Stand, One Shall Fall
achievements.description: Story: earn the right to take on eight-star assignments.

achievements.name: The Sapphire Star
achievements.description: Story: solve the mystery of the Elder Crossing - finish the base-game main story.

achievements.name: The Hunters Life for Me
achievements.description: Complete 50 optional quests.

achievements.name: An Inquisitive Mind
achievements.description: Complete your first investigation.

achievements.name: The Franchise Hunter
achievements.description: Complete 50 investigations.

achievements.name: Step into the Arena
achievements.description: Complete your first arena quest.

achievements.name: Nowhere to Go but Up
achievements.description: Complete 50 arena quests.

achievements.name: New World Settler
achievements.description: Establish five camps.

achievements.name: The Art of Camouflage
achievements.description: Escape the Jagras pack by hiding in some shrubs.

achievements.name: Angling for a Bite
achievements.description: Catch your first fish.

achievements.name: Mmm, So Tasty!
achievements.description: Cook your first well-done steak.

achievements.name: The Bigger They Are...
achievements.description: Mount your first monster.

achievements.name: A Living Fossil
achievements.description: Capture the rare endemic fish known as "the living fossil" (a Coelacanth) while out on an expedition or quest.

achievements.name: Snuggles for All
achievements.description: Capture a fluffy, snuggly rare endemic creature with a capture net.

achievements.name: Bristles for All
achievements.description: Capture a stiff, bristly rare endemic creature with a capture net.

achievements.name: Rainbow Bright
achievements.description: Capture a rare endemic creature that glitters like a rainbow with a capture net.

achievements.name: Commissioned Work
achievements.description: Obtain 100,000 research points.

achievements.name: Bourgeois Hunter
achievements.description: Possess 1,000,000 zenny.

achievements.name: Impregnable Defense
achievements.description: Obtain five highly rare pieces of armor.

achievements.name: Power is Everything
achievements.description: Obtain five highly rare weapons.

achievements.name: Movin On Up
achievements.description: Move into an upgraded room.

achievements.name: First Friends
achievements.description: Befriend your first Tailraider.

achievements.name: Bosom Buddies
achievements.description: Raise the proficiency of any Palico Gadget to level 10.

achievements.name: Monster Ph.D.
achievements.description: Max out the research level (up to high rank) for many monsters.

achievements.name: Temper Temper
achievements.description: Hunt your first tempered monster.

achievements.name: Indomitable
achievements.description: Hunt 50 tempered monsters.

achievements.name: Miniature Crown
achievements.description: Record your first miniature crown for monsters that appear from low or high rank.

achievements.name: Miniature Crown Collector
achievements.description: Obtain a miniature crown for 10 or more monsters that appear from low or high rank.

achievements.name: Miniature Crown Master
achievements.description: Obtain a miniature crown for many monsters in your hunting log.

achievements.name: Giant Crown
achievements.description: Record your first silver crown or higher for monsters that appear from low or high rank.

achievements.name: Giant Crown Collector
achievements.description: Obtain a gold crown for 10 or more monsters that appear from low or high rank.

achievements.name: Giant Crown Master
achievements.description: Obtain a gold crown for many monsters in your hunting log.

achievements.name: Capture Novice
achievements.description: Capture your first monster.

achievements.name: Capture Pro
achievements.description: Capture 50 monsters.

achievements.name: Elderslayer
achievements.description: Slay 50 elder dragons.

achievements.name: Monster Slayer
achievements.description: Hunt 100 large monsters.

achievements.name: Monster Hunter
achievements.description: Hunt 500 large monsters.

achievements.name: HELP!
achievements.description: Fire an SOS flare for the first time.

achievements.name: I Am the Reinforcements
achievements.description: Respond to an SOS flare, and help complete 10 quests.

achievements.name: Hunters United
achievements.description: Complete a quest via multiplayer.

achievements.name: Hunters United Forever
achievements.description: Complete 100 quests via multiplayer.

achievements.name: Spreading the Word
achievements.description: Collect over 50 Guild Cards.

achievements.name: Established Hunter
achievements.description: Reach hunter rank 100.

achievements.name: Conqueror of the Hinterlands
achievements.description: Unlock all achievements for Monster Hunter World: Iceborne.

achievements.name: The Beginning of a New Expedition
achievements.description: Iceborne story: earn the right to take on one-star Master Rank assignments.

achievements.name: Time to Get Serious
achievements.description: Iceborne story: earn the right to take on two-star Master Rank assignments.

achievements.name: The Elusive Elder Dragon
achievements.description: Iceborne story: earn the right to take on three-star Master Rank assignments.

achievements.name: Indomitable Spirit
achievements.description: Iceborne story: earn the right to take on four-star Master Rank assignments.

achievements.name: The Old Everwyrm
achievements.description: Iceborne story: earn the right to take on five-star Master Rank assignments.

achievements.name: An End and a Beginning
achievements.description: Iceborne story: solve the mystery of the Old Everwyrm by finishing the final Iceborne assignment, "Paean of Guidance".

achievements.name: To the Land of Discoveries
achievements.description: Iceborne: reach the Guiding Lands after the Iceborne story and complete its introductory quest.

achievements.name: Evolving Ecology
achievements.description: Iceborne: raise any single Guiding Lands region to level 7.

achievements.name: In Search of Rare Materials
achievements.description: Iceborne: gather from a Giant Ore outcrop and a Giant Bone outcrop in the Guiding Lands.

achievements.name: Insatiable Investigator
achievements.description: Iceborne: analyse 50 special monster tracks in the Guiding Lands.

achievements.name: Fate's Conclusion
achievements.description: Iceborne: slay Ruiner Nergigante in the Guiding Lands, removing the Master Rank cap.

achievements.name: Master Explorer
achievements.description: Establish all camps in the Hoarfrost Reach.

achievements.name: Source of Relaxation
achievements.description: Spend some time in a natural hot spring.

achievements.name: Clutch Claw Neophyte
achievements.description: Study the ways of the clutch claw.

achievements.name: Golden Gleam
achievements.description: Iceborne: capture a Goldspring Macaque from the hot springs in Hoarfrost Reach with a capture net.

achievements.name: Friendly Pointer
achievements.description: Iceborne: capture an Arrowhead Gekko in the Rotten Vale with a capture net.

achievements.name: Sweet Melody
achievements.description: Iceborne: capture a creature that makes a beautiful melody (a Blue Diva bird in the Wildspire Waste) with a capture net.

achievements.name: Submerged Mystery
achievements.description: Iceborne: fish up a Sealord's Crestfish at night in Hoarfrost Reach.

achievements.name: Celestial Illusion
achievements.description: Iceborne: capture a fantastical creature that floats through the sky (a Wintermoon Nettle in Hoarfrost Reach) with a capture net.

achievements.name: Deft Digger
achievements.description: Iceborne: catch a Moly in the Wildspire Waste region of the Guiding Lands with a capture net.

achievements.name: Creatures of the Earth
achievements.description: Iceborne: catch endemic life in all four Guiding Lands regions (Forest, Wildspire, Rotten Vale and Coral).

achievements.name: Unwavering Defense
achievements.description: Obtain five extremely rare pieces of armor.

achievements.name: Devastating Offense
achievements.description: Obtain five extremely rare weapons.

achievements.name: Personal Treasure
achievements.description: Iceborne: equip a pendant (weapon charm) - the first is given during the six-star story quest "Paean of Guidance".

achievements.name: First Ride
achievements.description: Use your first Raider Ride.

achievements.name: Experienced Rider
achievements.description: Use Raider Ride many times.

achievements.name: Fledgling Collector
achievements.description: Find your first treasure.

achievements.name: Veteran Collector
achievements.description: Find all treasure within a single locale.

achievements.name: Ultimate Collector
achievements.description: Find all treasure.

achievements.name: Remodeler
achievements.description: Change your room's interior for the first time.

achievements.name: Interior Decorator
achievements.description: Have 50 different types of room decor to choose from.

achievements.name: Architectural Artist
achievements.description: Have 120 different types of room decor to choose from.

achievements.name: Eager Engineer
achievements.description: Help the Steamworks 20 times.

achievements.name: Skilled Steamworker
achievements.description: Send the Steamworks into overdrive.

achievements.name: Another Miniature Crown
achievements.description: Obtain your first miniature crown for capturing endemic life in master rank.

achievements.name: Another Giant Crown
achievements.description: Obtain your first gold crown for capturing endemic life in master rank.

achievements.name: Fledgling Observer
achievements.description: Complete your first request for the Lynian Researcher.

achievements.name: Outstanding Observer
achievements.description: Complete many requests for the Lynian Researcher.

achievements.name: Helpful Hunter
achievements.description: Aid a low rank or high rank hunter on 10 quests as a master rank hunter.

achievements.name: Master of Masters
achievements.description: Reach master rank 200.

achievements.name: Monster Master
achievements.description: Maximize the research level for almost all large monsters.

achievements.name: True Miniature Crown Collector
achievements.description: Obtain a miniature crown for almost every monster in your hunting log.

achievements.name: True Large Crown Collector
achievements.description: Obtain a gold crown for almost every monster in your hunting log.

achievements.name: The True Hunt Begins
achievements.description: Hunt your first large monster in a master rank quest.

achievements.name: Hunter Prodigy
achievements.description: Hunt 100 large monsters in master rank quests.

achievements.name: Master Capturer
achievements.description: Capture 50 large monsters in master rank quests.

achievements.name: Master Slayer
achievements.description: Slay 50 elder dragons in master rank quests.

achievements.name: Confronting the Unknown
achievements.description: Iceborne: hunt your first variant monster (Shrieking Legiana, during the story).

achievements.name: Seen It All
achievements.description: Iceborne: hunt 30 variant monsters.
